entries.proposition: Cacna1g and Cacna1h were the only voltage-gated calcium channel genes expressed at all time points and the most expressed of the family, with TPM values from about 10 to about 35.
entries.snippet: two genes (Cacna1g and Cacna1h) were expressed at all time points. They code for Cav3.1 (Cacna1g) and Cav3.2 (Cacna1h), two low-threshold T-type Ca2+ channels. These two genes were the most expressed VGCC genes with TPM values ranging from ≈10 to ≈35

entries.proposition: Cacna1g mRNA was the major voltage-gated calcium channel transcript at E11 and E13, Cacna1h predominated at E17 and PN1, and Cacna1h rose about tenfold from E11 to PN1.
entries.snippet: At E11 and E13, Cacna1g mRNA (Cav3.1) was the major VGCC transcript, whereas Cacna1h mRNA (Cav3.2) predominated at E17 and PN1, showing a clear shift in the expression pattern of genes encoding T-type VGCC. Cacna1h was the most strongly induced gene with a number of transcripts increasing by a factor ≈10 from E11 to PN1.

entries.proposition: Cacna1i (Cav3.3) was not detected at E11 and E13 and increased thereafter.
entries.snippet: Five transcripts were not detected at the beginning of corticogenesis (E11 and E13); however, their abundance increased thereafter: Cacna1c (Cav1.2, L-type), Cacna1a (Cav2.1, P/Q-type), Cacna1b (Cav2.2, N-type), Cacna1e (Cav2.3, R-type), and Cacna1i (Cav3.3, T-type)

entries.proposition: The complete dataset is deposited at GEO accession GSE154677 and the results are expressed in transcripts per million.
entries.snippet: The complete dataset is accessible on the GEO repository at the following address: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE154677.

entries.proposition: Tissues were collected at embryonic days 11, 13 and 17 and at postnatal day 1.
entries.snippet: Tissues were collected at four ages: embryonic days 11 (E11), 13 (E13), and 17 (E17), and post-natal day 1 (PN1)

entries.proposition: The functional imaging in this paper concerned Chrnb2, Grik5, Orai3 and Trpm7 and not T-type channels.
entries.snippet: This study focused its attention on Chrnb2 (AchR β2), Grik5 (GluK5), Orai3 (Orai3), and Trpm7 (TRPM7).

entries.proposition: The authors cite earlier work for functional T-type channels in embryonic cortical cells; their own transcript data are described as indicating that calcium influx through low-threshold channels plays important roles during cortex formation.
entries.snippet: They were the predominant VGCC transcripts throughout corticogenesis, from E11 to PN1, indicating that Ca2+ influx through low-threshold VGCC plays important roles during the formation of the rodent cortex.

entries.proposition: The authors summarise that at the onset of corticogenesis the main surface calcium-uptake routes include Cav3.1, and at the end, ASIC1, Orai2, P2X2 and GluN1 emerged.
entries.snippet: the most important Ca2+ uptake routes of the cell surface at the onset of corticogenesis (Figure 6) are channels formed by TACAN, GluK5, Orai3, Cav3.1, TRPM7, and nAChR β2

entries.proposition: The authors state two limitations: that only some transcripts are translated and that post-translational modifications were not considered.
entries.snippet: only certain transcripts are translated to proteins, and this transcriptomic approach did not consider the post-translational modifications known to influence the activity and/or subcellular localization of proteins

entries.proposition: The authors state that the mRNA expression of auxiliary regulatory subunits of ion channels was not investigated.
entries.snippet: the mRNA expression of these regulatory subunits was not investigated

All bars carry error bars of standard error; no sample number per age is printed in the panels.

entries.proposition: Figure 5 read as an image: 2-APB raises Fluo-4 signal about 4 percent with calcium and about 3 percent without; zinc with calcium- and magnesium-free saline raises FluoZin-3 to about 1.45 at 8 minutes against about 1.1 with calcium and magnesium, and cadmium suppresses it; thapsigargin raises Fluo-4 by about 20 percent and lanthanum slows decay; puromycin leaves the baseline flat. No panel tests a T-type channel blocker.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5: 2-APB about 1.04 (+Ca) and 1.03 (-Ca); Zn 0Ca/0Mg about 1.45 vs about 1.1; Tg about 1.2, La slows decay; puromycin flat; no T-type blocker panel.
